capabilities: insert tab components using a tabs code block
edit tab content in place via double click, action button, or command
position the tab nav bar at top, left, right, or bottom
nest tabs and other code blocks using extra backticks or tildes
convert selected text into a tabs component via command
disambiguation: Not a tabbed interface for opening multiple notes; it renders tabbed sections inside a single note's content.
extras: Warns that tasks entered inside the tabs code block will not be recognized by the Tasks or Dataview plugins; a Todo section lists planned features such as drag-and-drop across files and Live Preview support.
intentEvidence: Thanks to the Code Tab plugin for the inspiration, but since it had not been updated for a long time
motivation: The author refactored the Code Tab plugin, which had not been updated for a long time and did not support editing content directly.
problem: Markdown has no native way to group and switch between multiple content sections within a single note.

relations.evidence: I refactored the plugin and added a lot of features.

summary: Renders tabbed content sections inside notes via a tabs code block, with in-place editing, nav positioning, and nesting.
